info.title: Judgment Pack Runner local pilot
info.description: Single local installation owner, one fixed pack release per job. Experimental evaluator; no external actions or schedules. Direct runner prefix /v1; authenticated Desk proxy /api/operations.

post.description: Project a retained v1 file or verify/derive a v2 ordered mapping, without network acquisition, persistence or evaluation. Invalid proof and derivation errors refuse preparation; valid rule unknowns remain policy data.

get.description: Trusted installation profiles and canonical digests. Read-only; profile installation is host configuration.
Offline input lineage bundle. Trust the profiles and release digest independently. Does not establish sealed-session completeness or policy truth.

post.description: Verify and derive a mapping v2 prefix. Returns the next instantiated acquisition request, or complete prepared input. Accepts source-only partial input; checks every trusted profile and class admission before returning any request. Performs no network calls, evaluation or persistence.

preparation.description: Server-computed for v2; never trusted from a caller.

Input.description: Manual facts/evidence, v1 selected file, or ordered v2 case/file/MCP mapping. Omit facts/evidence to use projection; supplied values must match. V2 verification requires installation profiles.

matrix.description: Optional serialized Runtime matrix with saved expectations. Omit only when no saved tests exist. It is evaluated afresh against the frozen pack and Runtime.

CreateJob.description: Requires explicit review. Only passed checks and explicitly reviewed not-run releases are admitted. Failed, incomplete or mismatched test evidence returns 409 release_not_ready. Coverage never gates. Reusing an immutable release and name is idempotent.

report.description: Retained Runtime packs test outputVersion 2, including rows and advisory coverage. Incomplete invocations may retain a diagnostic report.

mappingDigest.description: Runner-computed mapping digest; if supplied it must match.

SourceSnapshot.description: Retained JSON file (200,000 decoded bytes maximum). local-file requires selectedAt and forbids proof. google-drive requires the existing Desk DocumentObject proof with Drive selection, receipt response and sealed registry. Runner checks structural/byte binding, not cryptographic authenticity; consumers verify with their configured pin. No provider credentials. Snapshot max 1 MiB.

proof.description: Existing signed document acquisition and sealed registry contract; required for Google Drive.

factsText.description: Exact mapped facts JSON for consumers that cannot represent all JSON numbers losslessly.

evidenceText.description: Exact availability JSON; empty if omitted.

target.description: Non-root JSON Pointer destination. Targets must not overlap.
